NAMASTE.description: Both palms pressed flat together against the chest at heart level in the traditional greeting gesture.

PLEASE.description: Flat open hands positioned forward or open palm touching chest gently.

HELP.description: Closed dominant fist resting on open flat non-dominant palm, lifted upwards.

YES.description: Fist held upright at chest level with wrist flexing forward in a nodding motion.

NO.description: Index finger extended and waving laterally, or index and middle finger closing against thumb.

HOUSE.description: Fingertips of both hands meeting angled at the top resembling the roof of a house.

BOOK.description: Palms joined edge-to-edge opening up like a book.

WATER.description: W-shape or open hand brought near the lips/chin area.

FOOD.description: Fingertips pinched together tapping the lips twice.

PEACE.description: V sign (index and middle fingers extended) with both hands held steady.

ME.description: Index finger pointing directly toward the signer's chest.

YOU.description: Index finger pointing directly forward toward the conversational partner.

TEACHER.description: Flat hands near temples moving forward, followed by person marker sign.

DOCTOR.description: Index and middle fingers of dominant hand feeling the wrist pulse of non-dominant hand.

STUDENT.description: Dominant hand taking knowledge from non-dominant palm to forehead.

FRIEND.description: Index fingers hooked together, alternating sides.

HELLO.description: Open hand raised near temple swaying laterally in a waving sequence.

THANK_YOU.description: Flat hand fingertips touching chin/lips and translating forward and outward toward viewer.

GOODBYE.description: Hand held high fingers fluttering or waving goodbye horizontally.

WHAT.description: Both hands open, palms facing up, oscillating side to side with furrowed brow non-manual marker.

WHERE.description: Dominant index finger wagging side to side repeatedly with head tilted.

HOW_ARE_YOU.description: Curved hands touching chest and opening outwards facing upwards toward recipient.

SORRY.description: Fist rubbing in a circular clockwise motion over the chest.

MEET.description: Both hands with index fingers extended upright starting apart and approaching until touching.

GO.description: Index fingers pointing forward and accelerating away from the signer.

COME.description: Index fingers gesturing repeatedly inward towards the signer's chest.
